title: mimosa dolens var. rudis
intro: Mimosa dolens var. rudis, commonly known as the "Sensitive Plant", is a variety of the Mimosa pudica plant that belongs to the Fabaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, alleviating pain, and treating fever. The therapeutic actions of Mimosa dolens var. rudis include its use as an anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antipyretic agent, making it effective in treating conditions such as arthritis and skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties and are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
